testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of ferric ammonium citrate (ignition, ammonium hydroxide, permanganate)
testDefinitions.notes: USP Identification: (A) ignition leaves residue of iron oxide; (B) 6 N ammonium hydroxide darkens 1 in 100 solution without precipitate; (C) 0.3 mL KMnO4 TS and 4 mL mercuric sulphate TS to 5 mL of 1 in 100 solution, boiled, forms white precipitate. Covers all three identification rows.

testDefinitions.displayName: Protein content of marine collagen peptide (Kjeldahl titration)
testDefinitions.titrationEquivalencyFactorDerivation: stated: 1 mL 0.1 N H2SO4 = 1.4 mg N; protein factor 6.25; 1.4 x 6.25 = 8.75 mg protein per mL / 0.1 mEq = 87.5 mg/mEq
testDefinitions.notes: 100 mg sample digested with 5 g K2SO4/CuSO4/TiO2 (33:1:1) and 7 mL H2SO4; add 70 mL water, steam distil with 30 mL 2:5 NaOH into 15 mL 1:25 boric acid with methyl red-methylene blue TS (80-100 mL distillate). Titrate with 0.1 N sulfuric acid VS with blank correction. Protein (%) = (EP - B) x 0.1 x 14 x F x 6.25 / (W x 1000) x 100. F = 87.5 mg/mEq.

solutions.name: 0.1 N Sulfuric acid VS
solutions.instructions: Dilute 1.4 mL sulfuric acid to 500 mL with water. Standardize against 0.1 g anhydrous sodium carbonate in 20 mL water, methyl orange indicator, titrate to reddish colour. 1 mL 0.1 N sulfuric acid = 5.295 mg sodium carbonate.
solutions.notes: 1.4 mL sulfuric acid diluted to 500 mL with water. Standardized against 0.1 g anhydrous sodium carbonate, methyl orange indicator. 1 mL 0.1 N H2SO4 = 5.295 mg Na2CO3. House defaults applied: 3 replicates, factor 0.97-1.03, max RSD 0.2 %, valid 30 days, shelf life 30 days.
